prompt: You need to update Agent B in an active pipeline while Agents A and C process tasks. Safest approach?
explanation: Draining before updating prevents corrupted handoffs. Validating in isolation before reintroduction ensures the updated agent won't break the broader workflow.

options.text: Update Agent B immediately without stopping the pipeline
Drain in-flight tasks from Agent B, update it, validate in isolation, then reintroduce to the pipeline
Delete Agent B and recreate it fresh
Update all agents simultaneously for consistency
